description: Craftcon 2K26 – Imagine. Build. Beyond. Desh Bhagat University | 22–23 October 2026 Desh Bhagat University presents CRAFTED 2K26, a two-day student-focused event bringing together innovation, technology and competitive gaming. The event features two major competitions: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Internal Hackathon: An innovation-driven hackathon where students work on real-world problem statements and develop practical, technology-based solutions. Team Guidelines: Each team must have 1-6 members, including 1 Team Leader. All team members must belong to the same college/institution. Inter-college teams are not allowed. Students from different branches/specializations of the same college can participate together. At least 1 female team member is required. Each team will work on one selected problem statement. Teams will present their solution/prototype before the evaluation panel. Teams will be evaluated on innovation, technical feasibility, implementation, impact and presentation. Selected teams will proceed according to the applicable SIH process and guidelines. Gaming Competition: A competitive gaming event where participants will compete against other registered teams/players. Gaming Guidelines: Participants must register within the specified deadline. Players/teams must follow the game-specific rules provided by the organizers. Participants must use their registered account/team details. Any form of cheating, hacking, unfair gameplay or use of unauthorized software will result in disqualification. Participants must report at the designated venue/time. Match format, team size, game title and round structure will be communicated by the organizers. The decision of the tournament officials will be final. Event Details: Event: Craftcon 2K26 Dates: 22–23 October 2026 Venue: Desh Bhagat University Events: SIH Internal Hackathon & Gaming Competition Theme: Imagine. Build. Beyond. Build your idea. Challenge your skills. Compete to win.

Craftcon 2K26 – Imagine. Build. Beyond.

Desh Bhagat University | 22–23 October 2026

Desh Bhagat University presents CRAFTED 2K26, a two-day student-focused event bringing together innovation, technology and competitive gaming.

The event features two major competitions:

Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Internal Hackathon:

  • An innovation-driven hackathon where students work on real-world problem statements and develop practical, technology-based solutions.

Team Guidelines:

  • Each team must have 1-6 members, including 1 Team Leader.
  • All team members must belong to the same college/institution.
  • Inter-college teams are not allowed.
  • Students from different branches/specializations of the same college can participate together.
  • At least 1 female team member is required.
  • Each team will work on one selected problem statement.
  • Teams will present their solution/prototype before the evaluation panel.
  • Teams will be evaluated on innovation, technical feasibility, implementation, impact and presentation.
  • Selected teams will proceed according to the applicable SIH process and guidelines.

Gaming Competition:

  • A competitive gaming event where participants will compete against other registered teams/players.

Gaming Guidelines:

  • Participants must register within the specified deadline.
  • Players/teams must follow the game-specific rules provided by the organizers.
  • Participants must use their registered account/team details.
  • Any form of cheating, hacking, unfair gameplay or use of unauthorized software will result in disqualification.
  • Participants must report at the designated venue/time.
  • Match format, team size, game title and round structure will be communicated by the organizers.
  • The decision of the tournament officials will be final.

Event Details:

  • Event: Craftcon 2K26
  • Dates: 22–23 October 2026
  • Venue: Desh Bhagat University
  • Events: SIH Internal Hackathon & Gaming Competition
  • Theme: Imagine. Build. Beyond.
  • Build your idea. Challenge your skills. Compete to win.
